title: camscast: code, processed records and results for the evaluation of CAMS reanalysis PM10 against the Abu Dhabi regulatory monitoring network
description: Analysis code, processed observation-model records and result files for a study that evaluates surface PM10 of the CAMS EAC4 reanalysis against the 19-monitor regulatory network of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi (October 2022 to May 2024), shows that the PM10 values held by the OpenAQ archive for this network are 24-h running means, and identifies dust independently with AERONET and airport weather reports. Raw CAMS, AERONET and METAR files are not redistributed; the fetch scripts retrieve them.
